# Audit My Web

> Audit My Web is a free website audit tool that checks on-page SEO, structured data, and AI Readiness — the on-page signals correlated with being cited by AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. Enter a URL and get an instant scored report, no signup required.

## Tool

- [Audit My Web](https://auditmyweb.site/): Free SEO and AI Readiness audit. Checks title/meta tags, headings, indexability, HTTPS, structured data (JSON-LD, Open Graph, Twitter Cards), FAQ schema, AI crawler access (GPTBot, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, CCBot), llms.txt presence, and E-E-A-T signals.

## Related

- [Shrink My Tools](https://shrinkmytools.com/): Companion site with 18 free, browser-based tools — image resizing, PDF merge/split/compress, QR codes, JSON formatting, password generation, and more.
- [Shrink My Pics](https://shrinkmypics.com/): Free image resizer and converter.
